name: Canvas UI
tagline: 33 creative canvas WebGL components with a selectable-text API
description: A library of 33 creative canvas WebGL UI components — Liquid, Glass, Shatter, Blaze, VHS, Glitch, Decrypt Reveal, and more. Built in TypeScript and licensed MIT + Commons Clause, its HTML-in-canvas API keeps text selectable and links clickable, so effects don't destroy accessibility. Framework-agnostic across React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Preact, and vanilla, with a shadcn-compatible registry and MCP readiness.
highlights: 33 ready-made WebGL effects from Liquid to Decrypt Reveal
HTML-in-canvas keeps text selectable and links clickable
Framework-agnostic: React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Preact, vanilla
curatorNote: The rare effects library that treats accessibility as a feature — text stays selectable behind the WebGL.
